units.source_text: 在伊东续弈不久之后的一天，我问：

en.t: One day, not long after the match resumed in Ito, I asked:

units.source_text: 这盘棋结束之后，名人是重新住院，还是同往年一样到热海去避寒？

en.t: After this game was over, would the Master be hospitalized again, or would he go to Atami to escape the cold as he had in previous years?

units.source_text: 名人很是开心，冷不防地说：

en.t: The Master was in very good spirits, and quite unexpectedly he said:
